recentItems.title: 9News Brisbane | Monday September 7 | Full Bulletin
recentItems.description:
A battle to save homes and livelihoods is underway tonight - residents and crews are desperately fighting a blaze near Ipswich. It's one of more than 60 fires burning across the state, with property lost as authorities anxiously anticipate a forecast change in weather. In other news, a man and a woman have been killed in a light plane tragedy in Logan. The aircraft had barely taken off from Archerfield Airport before crashing into a paddock, sparking a grassfire and huge emergency response. | Subscribe and 🔔: http://9Soci.al/KM6e50GjSK9 | Get more breaking news at nine.com.au

recentItems.title: 9News Sydney | Monday September 7 | Full Bulletin
recentItems.description:
In this 9News Sydney bulletin presented by Peter Overton, federal politics heats up as One Nation leader Pauline Hanson and Barnaby Joyce propose allowing Australians early access to their superannuation. The proposal faces fierce opposition from Treasurer Jim Chalmers, Finance Minister Katy Gallagher, and Association of Superannuation Funds representative Mary Delahunty, with analysis provided by Political Editor Charles Croucher.

In state coverage, Premier Chris Minns, Attorney-General Michael Daley, and NSW Police Commissioner Mal Lanyon announce tough new legislation targeting teenage gangland hitmen. The policy faces criticism from Greens MP Sue Higginson and Opposition Leader Kellie Sloane, as reported by Liz Daniels. Meanwhile, reporter Massilia Aili details a violent Canterbury kebab shop brawl that left three men stabbed.

Further reports include a $15 million illicit tobacco bust in Western Sydney, an AMSA maritime rescue of a Canadian sailor near Christmas Island, veterans protesting healthcare caps outside Parliament, and grieving mother Elouise Massa announcing an independent election bid for Manly. Finally, NRL Executive Chairman Peter V'landys unveils plans for an interactive "NRL Land" theme park. | Subscribe and 🔔: http://9Soci.al/KM6e50GjSK9 | Get more breaking news at nine.com.au

recentItems.title: 9News Melbourne | Monday September 7 | Full Bulletin
recentItems.description:
A gunman is on the run after shooting dead a young Thomastown tradie. Loved ones have paid tribute to Daniel Hussein, while his heartbroken dad says no one deserves to lose their son on Father's Day. In other news, Less than twelve weeks until the state election, tunnelling has started on the $33 billion Suburban Rail Loop. The Coalition's vowing to pause it in their first 100 days if they win in November, an idea Labor's dismissed as nonsense. | Subscribe and 🔔: http://9Soci.al/KM6e50GjSK9 | Get more breaking news at nine.com.au
